note: Treg subsetting on CCR4 × HLA-DR, four-quadrant layout. CCR4pos_HLADRpos: activated skin-homing Treg — upper-right quadrant (CCR4+, HLA-DR+). CCR4pos_HLADRneg: skin-homing Treg, not activated — lower-right quadrant (CCR4+, HLA-DR-). CCR4neg_HLADRpos: activated Treg without skin-homing bias — upper-left quadrant (CCR4-, HLA-DR+). CCR4neg_HLADRneg: resting non-skin-homing Treg — lower-left quadrant (both -).
tips: Treg functional / activation quadrants. CCR4 marks skin/mucosa-homing capacity and is associated with tissue-homing effector Treg. HLA-DR is an activation marker on Treg and is enriched on effector Treg with enhanced suppressive capacity (reported e.g. in Miyara et al. 2009 and follow-up work). CCR4pos_HLADRpos: CCR4+ HLA-DR+. CCR4pos_HLADRneg: CCR4+ HLA-DR-. CCR4neg_HLADRpos: CCR4- HLA-DR+. CCR4neg_HLADRneg: CCR4- HLA-DR-.
